PF Nexus (4.0.0)

PF Nexus API

B2B marketplace API connecting renewable energy project developers with capital providers.

Standard Query Parameters

All paginated list endpoints support the following query parameters.

Pagination

Parameter Type Description Example
_page integer Page number (1-indexed) _page=2
_per_page integer Items per page _per_page=25

Sorting

Parameter Type Description Example
_sort string Field name to sort by _sort=created_on
_order string ASC or DESC _order=DESC

Simple filtering - _where

Pass a JSON object of field/value pairs. All conditions are ANDed together.

_where={"projectstatus":"Live","user_id":123}

Advanced filtering - _filterby

_filterby accepts a JSON rule tree that supports AND/OR combinators and nested groups. This is the correct way to express complex filters such as matching multiple status values.

Simple field filter

{
  "combinator": "and",
  "rules": [
    { "field": "projectstatus", "operator": "=", "value": "Live" }
  ]
}

OR combinator - multiple status values

{
  "combinator": "or",
  "rules": [
    { "field": "projectstatus", "operator": "=", "value": "Live" },
    { "field": "projectstatus", "operator": "=", "value": "Contract-Pending" }
  ]
}

Nested AND/OR - combining an OR status filter with an AND condition

Use this pattern when you need to combine an OR group (e.g. multiple status values) with an additional AND condition (e.g. a specific user).

{
  "combinator": "and",
  "rules": [
    {
      "combinator": "or",
      "rules": [
        { "field": "projectstatus", "operator": "=", "value": "Live" },
        { "field": "projectstatus", "operator": "=", "value": "Contract-Pending" }
      ]
    },
    { "field": "user_id", "operator": "=", "value": "456" }
  ]
}

Note: Use _page / _per_page for pagination, not an id-cursor inside _filterby.

Related objects - _expand

Comma-separated list of relation names to eager-load alongside each result.

_expand=user,project

Hard limit - _limit

Caps the total number of results returned regardless of pagination settings.

_limit=100

users-hubspot-chat-token

Returns an opaque, temporary HubSpot-issued visitor identification token for the authenticated user. The token is generated by calling HubSpot's Visitor Identification API and should be passed to window.hsConversationsSettings.identificationToken on the frontend to associate the chat session with the known HubSpot contact. Tokens are short-lived and unique per call.

users-subscription-switch-plan

Admin-only endpoint to switch a user's subscription plan whilst preserving their billing interval. Handles proration for active subscriptions and skips it during free trials.

Authorizations:
ApiKeyAuth
Request Body schema: application/json
required
user_id
required
integer

The PF Nexus user ID whose plan should be switched.

tier_id
required
string
Enum: "financier" "project_owner"

The target plan tier ID.

billing_period
string
Enum: "annually" "quarterly"

Optional. The billing interval to switch to. Defaults to the user's existing interval if omitted.

apply_discount
boolean

Optional. Whether to apply the new tier's discount coupon from pricing config. Defaults to true.

Responses

activitytimeline

users-activitytimeline

Returns a list of recent activity events (last 3 days) across the platform. Used to populate the activity feed on the home dashboard. This endpoint is public — no authentication required. Response data is preferentially served from a Redis cache rebuilt every 5 minutes by cron job. If the cache has not yet been populated (e.g. first boot), the controller falls back to a direct database query.

Responses

Production server

https://api.pfnexus.com/api/users/activitytimeline
